title: Lifecycle notifications and opt-in external adapters
objective: Surface required lifecycle events in the active Agent/CLI session and support optional external notification adapters without a daemon.
acceptance_criteria: Start/finish, approval, repeated worker failure, unrecoverable CI, PR ready/Merge waiting, and deployment failure are surfaced.
External notification is opt-in and occurs only during active execution or configured workflow.
undo_classification: Disable only configured node-owned notification adapters; never send external messages without opt-in.
approval_requirements: Explicit opt-in and configuration before external notifications.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries for local processing; external failures do not trigger duplicate sends without idempotency checks.
